title: Add session-reconcile tests for sameQueueHold, the path hold-only changes reach the UI by
outcome: A regression in the queueHold comparison of sameSessionSummary fails a test.
acceptance: ui/src/session-reconcile.test.ts covers sameQueueHold through reconcile: summaries identical except queueHold.retryAt give a new session object; an identical hold keeps the object; a hold present then absent gives a new object.
